title: Glomerulus, SEM
creator: David Gregory & Debbie Marshall
license_basis: Owning catalogue item digital location explicitly provides license label and URL; owning work page independently states CC BY 4.0.
modifications: None: full-resolution catalogue JPEG retained with instrument footer. This is the IIIF full-size download, not a claim to raw microscope-acquisition data.
species: Unreported in owning catalogue. No human/rat/mouse specimen identity inferred.
preparation: SEM identified by owning catalogue; fixation, drying, coating, section/exposure preparation and specimen state unreported.
scale: Native instrument footer includes bar and literal 10.0U annotation; unit and calibration not independently documented in catalogue, so no physical dimensions measured or inferred here.
appearance_evidence: Actually inspected grayscale surface micrograph of exposed convoluted glomerular tuft, with fine branching/process patterns. SEM contrast reflects prepared specimen/electron detection, not living tissue color.
geometry_evidence: Observed tuft surface morphology. Not a registered gross-organ section, complete nephron connection graph or layer-by-layer wall section.
behavior_evidence: None: static prepared image, not filtration dynamics or molecular trajectories.

reconstructions.method: Original source-checked sectional kidney and separate-scale nephron arrangement; hand-authored vector coordinates, not atlas segmentation or specimen measurement.
reconstructions.limits: Gross organ and nephron panels have separate scales. Both corpuscles are cortical; long loop extends further into medulla. Cortical columns are continuous with and use the same fill as outer cortex. The unfilled sinus cavity surrounds a separate gold renal pelvis/drainage path; pale branches summarize calyces without resolving individual cups. Counts, shapes, distances, colors and proportions illustrative.

reconstructions.method: Original unscaled locally flattened filtration-wall reconstruction; lumen→surface layer/fenestrated endothelium→continuous GBM→podocyte slit→capsular space.
reconstructions.limits: Exaggerated glycocalyx and fenestra/slit widths. Two endothelial fragments depict one fenestrated sheet, not a junction gap. Matrix remains continuous. Foot processes belong to distinct podocytes. Arrow indicates direction only; no sieve cutoff or measured kinetics.

inspection: Native-dimension source file inspected with view_image. Both original SVG reconstructions rendered to private PNG previews and inspected for labeling and compartment geometry; barrier label/arrow overlap and contact gaps were repaired. Actual chapter responsive/control/print/browser production inspection remains separate.
